claims: Evaluate urgently for dialysis indication given creatinine 10.3-15.2 mg/dL and BUN 63-108 mg/dL in a dialysis patient, and arrange hemodialysis if indicated.

Recheck phosphate and manage hyperphosphatemia (7.4-8.1 mg/dL) with phosphate binders and dialysis as indicated.
Assess and manage metabolic acidosis with anion gap 24-34 mEq/L and bicarbonate 18-24 mEq/L.

Monitor blood glucose and manage hyperglycemia (glucose 208 mg/dL).
Continue telemetry and ST segment monitoring given cardiovascular risk and electrolyte abnormalities.
Perform fall and pressure ulcer prevention measures given bedfast status and Braden score risk.
Continue home medications including cinacalcet, calcium acetate, and Nephrocaps as ordered.
